Magnesium Silicate E553(a); Silicato de magnesio. CAS — 1343-88-0. ATC — A02AA05. ATC Vet — QA02AA05. NOTE. The code E553(a) has also been applied to magnesium tri- silicate. Pharmacopoeias. In Jpn. Also in USNF. USNF 26 (Magnesium Silicate). A compound of magnesium ox- ide and silicon dioxide. It contains not less than 15.0% of mag- nesium oxide and not less than 67.0% of silicon dioxide, calcu- lated on the ignited basis. It is a fine, white, odourless powder, free from grittiness. Insoluble in water and in alcohol. It is readily decomposed by mineral acids. pH of a well-mixed 10% suspen- sion in water is between 7.0 and 10.8.
